reviewed_by: Claude (health-liveness); selection reviewed against the diff by the implementing agent
reason: Product: the UI connection monitor read authenticated /api/v1/health every 5 s; each read checks out a database session and sends a worker identity RPC, so a busy Core missed the 5 s deadline and was reported as 'Nebula Core is unavailable'. Core now serves an unauthenticated GET /api/v1/health/live (supervisor and single-process app) with no credential lookup, database session or worker call. The ApiClient records any sub-500 response as reachability evidence; the monitor skips probes while traffic is answered, probes liveness when idle, reads full health every 30 s (every 5 s while the API is not ready), and only failed liveness probes count toward loss. Recovery still re-reads full health. The two mocked outage journeys now fail every Core request instead of only /health, which is how a real outage looks.
exclusions: core-connection-resilience/assistant-real-* entries are not selected: those projects' grep does not match the real-Core outage test, so they select nothing; that test was run locally instead under the real-core project against a LAN-bound Core (passed). The supervisor test's PostgreSQL variant skips without NEBULA_TEST_POSTGRES_URL. No setting or operator feature was added, so the settings catalog and product knowledge index are unchanged.
